jobs.objective: Implement RFC 0168 P0 in Go from current main, not from the canceled stale run branch. Read the required context docs in full first; do not re-litigate the accepted per-lane pooled uid direction or D272. This v2 build must close the first run's three blocking review findings: F1 full return-scrub-proof semantics, F2 generation enforcement on attestation and control frames, and F3 per-job worktree grants for the leased uid. Preserve the accepted pieces from the first run, including the D272 provider-credential discriminator and supervisor-scoped scratch bearer path. Use the next free runtime migration after RFC 0171's 0046_generated_records.sql, currently expected to be 0047 after rechecking; do not overwrite or delete RFC 0171 generated-records files, routes, docs, or schema. Owner bundle 0023 currently appears free but must be rechecked before use. Implement the P0 slice: daemon-owned lane_uid_leases persistence with active, scrubbing, quarantined, and returned states; monotonic generation; repository, session, and supervisor links; scrub proof and failure fields; held-uid uniqueness; reservations; authority inventory; static host-provisioned pool leasing at supervise.start with host-global exhaustion and typed lane_uid_pool_exhausted refusal; no fallback to the shared lane user and no daemon useradd or userdel; session close plus recovery reaper return, scrub, and proof flow with S1-S3 and P1-P5; classifyPoolUIDTaskState rather than processZombie; quarantine on failed proof; fail-closed procfs read errors; stuck-scrub redrive; leaked active-to-scrubbing reaper; proof-gated operator retry from quarantined to returned; operator-visible doctor plus recovery surface; leased uid plus generation bound into attestation, control frame, and report paths; ACL provisioning as an allowlist and exclude-at-traversal source grants, with no group ACL under .striatum, .git, or provider credential caches; physical no-symlink-follow recursion; per-leased-uid scratch and per-job worktree grants; per-uid PG reject coverage; writeEphemeralMCPConfig rooted at .striatum/scratch/<STRIATUM_SUPERVISOR_ID>/ with os.TempDir fallback and never scratch-root fallback; credential-cache resolution-domain guard covering CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR, CODEX_HOME, and any in-scope provider-owned credential selector the adapter declares. D272 binding follow-up remains mandatory: add a discriminator to the OQ4.1.2 coverage-gap gate so it fails closed only for provider-owned credential selectors, preserves typed lane_uncovered_credential_selector_inside_repo for uncovered provider credential-dir selectors resolving in-repo, and proves legitimate in-repo non-credential lane env such as AGY_HOME or FIXTURE_CONFIG_DIR still launches. Add focused tests for the named A1-A26 surfaces needed by the code you land, especially A21, A22-A25, the secure-storage selector, F1-F3 above, the D272 positive control, and no-regression of ordinary lane env. Update docs that move with the build: RFC 0168 status, roadmap row 2b, operator brief, README and CHANGELOG or reference docs if source behavior changes, and command-authority matrix if any RPC or route authority changes. Do not add a new decision unless implementation requires reopening the D272 security boundary. Run at least cd go && go build ./... && go vet ./... plus targeted go tests for touched packages; run make lint, make typecheck, make check-docs, and smoke when feasible. Publish DRAFT.md summarizing files changed, each design assertion and gate discharged, tests run, and any verifier or operator residuals.
